commands: set -euo pipefail; SOURCE="$HOME/esp/esp-idf"; ALIAS="$HOME/esp/esp-idf-v5.5.4"; test "$(git -C "$SOURCE" describe --tags --exact-match)" = 'v5.5.4'; if [ -e "$ALIAS" ] || [ -L "$ALIAS" ]; then test "$(cd "$ALIAS" && pwd -P)" = "$(cd "$SOURCE" && pwd -P)"; else ln -s "$SOURCE" "$ALIAS"; fi; test -L "$ALIAS"; test "$(readlink "$ALIAS")" = "$SOURCE"; . "$ALIAS/export.sh" >/dev/null; VERSION=$(idf.py --version); printf '%s\n' "$VERSION"; test "$VERSION" = 'ESP-IDF v5.5.4'; printf 'ESP32-C6 versioned ESP-IDF path ready\n'
